body.message:
We would like to inform you that we attempted to collect the payment through Booking.com; however, unfortunately, the payment was unsuccessful.

As an alternative, we can share a secure payment link with you to complete the payment. Once the payment is successfully completed, we will be able to confirm your booking.

Please note that, at the moment, your booking remains unconfirmed due to the pending payment.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
